title: About CAS Development — design and build studio in Kyiv
description: CAS Development: design, renovation and construction studio founded in Kyiv in 2016. 150+ projects in Ukraine and abroad, 12-month warranty.
lead: CAS Development is a studio where architecture meets detail. Founded in Kyiv in 2016, it designs interiors, renovates and builds turnkey — from compact apartments to private houses, restaurants and offices.

p: Since 2016 we have completed more than 150 projects in Ukraine and abroad. We do not copy trends: first we understand how you live or work, and then we create the space around that.
Every project starts with a brief and a personal meeting and ends with the handover of the property; we supervise the work at every stage.
Furniture and materials come directly from China through our own Ozdoba line: minimum order from $500, delivery 30–60 days.

items.p: We remove the unnecessary and keep the essence. Every detail has its place.
Materials, solutions and contractors proven over the years.
Regular photo reports and an estimate without hidden items.
No templates: every project reflects a particular person.
The studio’s home base: apartments, houses and commercial spaces with site visits.
Design, renovation, construction and furnishing across the country.
Design projects and furnishing for clients in European countries.
Online design and project support in the USA and other countries.
Founder and CEO — leads every project from the first meeting to handover.
Project manager — schedule, crews, purchasing and regular reports.
Interior designer — concept, style, 3D visualisations and materials.
Design engineer — layouts, working drawings and specifications.
AI developer — website, requests, assistants and automation.
